source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 6 mai — «Sfântul Mucenic Varvar»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Βάρβαρος»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and the rank matches: doxologia's «Sfântul Mucenic Varvar» against saint.gr's Άγιος among the martyrs. **The Greek adds one fact and one couplet and no more.** The fact is the manner of his death, which the folder did not have: «Ο Άγιος Βάρβαρος μαρτύρησε δια ξίφους», he was martyred by the sword. The couplet plays the name against his executioner — «Τὴν κλῆσιν ἡμῖν Βάρβαρος σὺ γεννάδα, / Ὁ δ' αὖ τεμών σε, βάρβαρος τὴν καρδίαν» — you, noble one, are Barbarus to us in name, but he who cut you down was a barbarian in his heart. **He is not Barbara the great martyr**, whose name the site glosses nearby, and not the robber Barbarus other calendars keep. Still no year, no country, no emperor, no relics and no hymn.
